---
title: "Shark attacks"
---

The Global Shark Attack File (GSAF) is a public database of reported shark-human incidents from around the world. Records can include details such as where and when an incident occurred, what the person was doing, and the outcome.

Fear of sharks can feel greater than the risk: incidents are uncommon, but dramatic stories can make rare events especially memorable. Sharks deserve respect, while the data can help put reported encounters in perspective.

The **Map** page shows recorded shark attacks by country. The **Trends** page compares fatal and non-fatal attacks by activity, including activities with at least 50 incidents with known outcomes.
